title: Pure Wind-Up
summary: Wind-Up cards only, with staples and an automatic Extra Deck. Wind-Up monsters each use their effect once while face-up, then reset by leaving the field and coming back. Wind-Up Magician calls a small Wind-Up from the Deck whenever another Wind-Up's effect activates. Wind-Up Rat turns itself to Defense to revive one. Wind-Up Shark joins from the hand whenever a Wind-Up is summoned and shifts its Level by one. Wind-Up Rabbit banishes a Wind-Up until your next Standby Phase, which resets it. Wind-Up Factory searches a small Wind-Up each turn a Wind-Up effect activates. The swarm makes Rank 3 and Rank 4 Wind-Up Xyz, and Wind-Up Zenmaintenance, the newest card (2018), searches any Wind-Up card. Wind-Up Hunter and Wind-Up Carrier Zenmaity are Forbidden.
main: Calls a small Wind-Up when another Wind-Up's effect activates.
Turns itself to Defense to revive a Wind-Up.
Joins when a Wind-Up is summoned; shifts its Level by one.
Banishes a Wind-Up until next turn, resetting its effect.
Recovers a Wind-Up from the GY.
Calls a small Wind-Up when destroyed in battle.
Gives a Wind-Up a Level and 600 ATK.
Searches a small Wind-Up each turn a Wind-Up effect activates.
Revives a Wind-Up with its effects negated.
Flips your Wind-Ups face-down to reset them.
Attaches Wind-Ups to a Machine Xyz; ranks a Wind-Up Xyz up by one.
extra: Newest Link-2: searches a Wind-Up card; swaps a Wind-Up for a copy from the Deck.
Rank 4: grows per material; flips a monster face-down for the turn.
Rank 3: survives destruction, then destroys a card.
Rank 0 Xyz: stacks on Utopic Future, cannot be destroyed by battle or effects, and negates and steals monster effects.
